prompt: 검색 유입과 상품 공유 미리보기가 중요한 공개 커머스 사이트를 설계해줘.
assertions: tech-stack.md selects and justifies an SSR/SSG-capable rendering profile instead of forcing CSR
requirements include canonical metadata, structured data, sitemap, status codes, and Core Web Vitals
the compatibility matrix cites primary release and engine constraints

prompt: 관리자와 조회자 역할이 있는 프로덕션 대시보드 인증을 추가해줘.
assertions: BFF HttpOnly session cookie or OIDC Authorization Code with PKCE is selected explicitly
no token, JWT, session ID, or refresh token is persisted in browser storage
CSRF, CORS, single-flight refresh, server authorization, 401, and 403 tests are specified

prompt: 새 단일 React 웹앱을 만들고 Claude harness도 함께 배포해줘.
assertions: all skills, agents, scripts, evals, and settings are copied
validate-harness.mjs runs successfully in the generated project
the generated orchestrators have no missing subagent dependency

prompt: OpenAPI에는 nullable 필드와 422 envelope가 있지만 MSW와 query 타입이 다른 프로젝트를 검증해줘.
assertions: api-contract-verifier reports producer and consumer locations
runtime schema, nullable fields, error envelope, and MSW drift are checked
the verifier returns findings without editing source files

prompt: 모바일 overflow와 키보드 focus 문제가 의심되는 앱을 브라우저에서 검증해줘.
assertions: Playwright runs Chromium desktop and mobile projects
axe, keyboard navigation, focus visibility, console errors, and failed requests are checked
missing Playwright infrastructure results in BLOCKED rather than PASS

prompt: S3와 CloudFront로 승인 기반 프로덕션 배포 파이프라인까지 만들어줘.
assertions: GitHub Actions are pinned to full commit SHAs
AWS authentication uses OIDC role assumption without long-lived access keys
production environment approval, least permissions, artifact digest, smoke check, and rollback are documented

prompt: 공개 TypeScript 라이브러리와 안전한 npm publish workflow를 만들어줘.
assertions: npm trusted publishing and provenance are used without a long-lived npm token
publint, attw, pack dry-run, and consumer fixtures validate package exports
publish permissions are isolated to a protected environment

prompt: 테스트 실패가 있는 기존 프로젝트를 검증하고 수정 담당자를 알려줘.
assertions: verifier agents have no Write or Edit tools
the orchestrator persists returned reports
fixes are routed to the smallest owner agent set and no snapshot update or auto-fix runs

prompt: 401, 422, 500과 offline 복구가 중요한 업무 앱을 만들어줘.
assertions: AppError preserves status, code, details, cause, and request ID
4xx errors render inline while unrecoverable 5xx errors use QueryErrorResetBoundary
retry decisions do not parse human-readable error messages

prompt: WebSocket으로 실시간 채팅, 읽음 상태, 접속자 presence를 구현해줘. 차트나 시간축 데이터는 없어.
assertions: the realtime provider contract path is used — managed provider consumption, connection state shown as UI state, canonical refetch on reconnect
code-reviewer applies the stream static check (unbounded buffers, listener/timer cleanup, Mock transport import, unvalidated messages) because a WebSocket stream exists

prompt: 테마와 언어 설정만 브라우저에 저장하는 간단한 웹앱을 만들어줘. 업무 데이터 CRUD나 정렬·이동은 없어.
assertions: developer implements bounded, runtime-validated preference persistence that falls back to defaults when stored values are missing, invalid, or from an older shape
code-reviewer applies the browser-storage static check: persisted JSON is parsed as untrusted input rather than type-asserted, and a parse failure leads to a reset path instead of a crash loop

prompt: package.json에 lint와 coverage script가 없는데 기존 QA Markdown에는 모든 명령이 exit 0 PASS라고 적혀 있어. 그대로 릴리스해도 되는지 검증해줘.
assertions: Markdown command tables are not trusted without quality-runner machine receipts
missing package scripts and zero discovered tests produce BLOCKED receipts rather than fabricated exit code zero
receipts bind actual command, cwd, engine, process exit, test files, output hashes, and the current source fingerprint
source changes invalidate prior receipts, signed attestation, and manifest v3, and HANDOFF remains blocked until isolated CI and the release gate pass

prompt: 기존 칸반 보드에 마감일 필터만 추가해줘. 현재 카드 API와 저장 형식, 디자인은 유지하고 관련 없는 리팩터링은 하지 마.
assertions: CHANGE_MODE is existing-change and change-scope.md records target behavior, allowed paths, preserved contracts, non-goals, expected change budget, and test evidence before the first source edit
only the smallest owner agent set needed for the filter and its integration is invoked, while unrelated design, dependency, routing, and state rewrites remain out of scope
any newly discovered public contract or cross-slice scope expansion is documented with root cause and blast radius before those paths are edited
code-reviewer compares git diff paths and stat against the brief and fails unexplained broad rewrites, format-only noise, or unrelated changes

prompt: 기존 사내 React 서비스에 다중 삭제 API 두 개만 OpenAPI에서 연결해줘. 기존 API client와 타입, MSW는 유지하고 나머지 수백 개 endpoint는 생성하거나 변경하지 마.
assertions: CHANGE_MODE is existing-change and the integration overlay records app root, package manager, aliases, API client, auth context, UI library, MSW activation, and current generator
the OpenAPI source is inspected without committing a full snapshot and only the two operation IDs or path plus method pairs enter the adoption manifest
an existing generator is reused; when none exists a narrow generator or handwritten validated adapter is proposed before source edits
generated output is isolated behind a stable adapter and diff budget, unrelated endpoints and public contracts remain unchanged, and Mock handlers share the selected request and response contract
rollback instructions identify generated files, commands, evidence, and safe removal boundaries from change-scope, the diff and resume-manifest

prompt: Playwright 시각 테스트는 통과했다고 적혀 있지만 baseline PNG가 최근 수정됐고 승인 manifest의 hash는 이전 값이야. 디자인 릴리스 가능 여부를 검증해줘.
assertions: visual-regression-verifier remains read-only and never runs --update-snapshots
browser visualEvidence binds the visual contract, test assertions, approved manifest, and current PNG SHA-256
a baseline hash mismatch or missing approval metadata produces BLOCKED rather than accepting the new image
baseline promotion requires explicit human review of before, after, diff, target, and reason

prompt: 라이트·다크 테마와 한국어·영어를 지원하는 대시보드의 모바일 overflow, sticky header focus 가림, 폰트 로딩 후 카드 이동을 시각 검증해줘.
assertions: the contract selects a risk-based state, viewport, theme, and locale matrix instead of an unbounded Cartesian product
the matrix includes 320 CSS pixel reflow or 400 percent zoom equivalent and a representative desktop viewport
font readiness, frozen clock and data, disabled animation, locale, timezone, DPR, and reduced motion are deterministic
focus obscuring, target size, axe, keyboard behavior, and CLS are checked alongside pixel comparison

prompt: Figma의 버튼 variant와 design token은 바뀌었는데 React 컴포넌트와 MUI theme가 예전 값을 사용하는지 확인해줘.
assertions: Figma MCP or export access is treated as an explicit capability with a local export and hash fallback
Code Connect or an equivalent mapping links the design component to the actual code component when available
DTCG token type, value, alias resolution, theme variants, and the Figma to token to CSS to UI-lane theme consumer mapping are checked
AI vision findings remain advisory while deterministic token, structural, and screenshot evidence controls the release gate

prompt: 기존 업무 화면이 전반적으로 어색하고 복잡해. 더 자연스럽게 고도화하는 기획을 해줘. 아직 API나 기술 스택은 정하지 않았어.
assertions: the first intake asks no more than three questions about target screen, primary user task, current pain, and observable success before API, files, libraries, or deployment
ambiguous discomfort is analyzed through hierarchy, mode separation, affordance, layout stability, and state clarity before copy changes
requirements.md records the product frame, evidence, assumptions, and a current planning memo, and ux-brief.md records critical states, without creating implementation or prototype source

prompt: 표와 차트가 같이 있는 권한 관리 대시보드에 스크린샷 주석이 여러 개 있어. 선택, 일괄 삭제, disabled, 부분 실패까지 포함해서 기획해줘.
assertions: the automatic UX Check covers first-glance hierarchy, next action, misunderstanding risk, direction, and Phase 2 prototype checks
annotations are batched and normalized into target, user intent, scope, and verification rather than copied as coordinates
normal, empty, loading, error, partial, permission, and destructive states are traced to screens, owners, and evidence

prompt: 실제 고객 데이터 연결 여부가 아직 불명확한 분석 화면을 기획해줘. 먼저 Mock으로 리뷰할 수도 있고 범위를 줄이거나 나눌지 판단이 필요해.
assertions: planning selects mock, dev-read-only, real-read-only, or production-integration-later with safety and Mock-to-real transition conditions
effort is expressed as S, M, L, or XL with drivers, invest/reduce/split guidance, smallest visible review unit, and a separate production integration delta rather than invented calendar estimates
plan-reviewer always returns PASS, NEEDS_DECISION, or BLOCKED and exposes at most three priority decisions before Phase 2

prompt: 검색 유입이 중요한 공개 행사 안내 사이트를 만들어줘. 행사 목록과 상세 페이지가 검색엔진과 소셜 공유에 잘 노출돼야 해.
assertions: tech-stack.md declares PUBLIC_EXPOSURE: yes and layout-designer produces _workspace/02_design/seo-spec.md with per-route title, description, canonical, and OG rows matching the actual route inventory
robots.txt and sitemap rules are specified in seo-spec.md and noindex routes are excluded from the sitemap
the CSR SEO limitation and SSR migration trigger are recorded in the spec instead of silently promising crawler visibility
seo-verifier returns qa-seo.md and a missing seo-spec with a public-exposure requirement is reported as BLOCKED, not PASS
once seo-spec.md exists, qa-seo.md is a required release report and its absence or non-passing result blocks the release manifest

prompt: 사내 관리자만 로그인해서 쓰는 재고 관리 도구를 만들어줘. 외부 공개나 검색 노출은 없어.
assertions: tech-stack.md declares PUBLIC_EXPOSURE: no, no seo-spec.md is produced, and seo-verifier is not invoked for an authenticated internal tool
no robots.txt/sitemap/OG scaffolding is generated without a public-exposure requirement

prompt: 성능 예산이 정의된 기존 대시보드 프로젝트를 검증해줘. 번들이 예산을 넘는지와 런타임 지표를 확인해줘.
assertions: performance-verifier runs only when _workspace/02_design/performance-budget.md exists and reads bundle sizes from build evidence and deployment artifacts, not estimates
runtime metrics without browser evidence are reported as NOT_MEASURED and never converted to PASS
budget violations name the exceeded row, the measured bytes, and an owner agent from the retry mapping
once performance-budget.md exists, qa-perf.md is a required release report and its absence or non-passing result blocks the release manifest

prompt: 한국어와 영어를 모두 지원하는 고객 포털을 만들어줘. 언어 전환 시 입력 중인 폼이 유실되면 안 돼.
assertions: the confirmed spec declares libraries.i18n and shape routing inserts /i18n-setup, whose developer spawn owns _workspace/02_design/i18n-spec.md and src/shared/lang/**
all locale catalogs under src/shared/lang/ share an identical key set and untranslated values carry TODO_TRANSLATE instead of invented translations
locale routing segments are only specified in i18n-spec.md and are implemented by the developer spawn that owns the routing scope, not by the i18n-setup spawn
ux-validator checks translation completeness and hardcoded user-facing strings when i18n-spec.md exists

prompt: 운영에 들어갈 예약 서비스라서 프론트 에러 추적과 웹바이탈 수집이 필요해. 릴리즈별로 오류를 구분하고 개인 정보는 수집하면 안 돼.
assertions: the spec libraries declare an observability role that developer implements, and environment-scaffolder hands the source map upload to the deploy workflow as a contract without executing it
error tracking initialization lives under src/shared/observability/ with release/environment tags injected from build info and PII scrubbing enabled by default
no DSN or credential literal appears in source and dev mode does not send events

prompt: 팀 업무 현황 대시보드를 만들어줘. 디자인 취향은 아직 못 정했는데 밀도가 높은 게 좋을지 여백이 있는 게 좋을지 모르겠어.
assertions: the undecided density preference is recorded as ASSUMPTION(시안 확정) instead of an invented value, with the divergence-research protocol committing a single direction and recording the rejected alternative
design-preview-builder generates dependency-free static previews under _workspace/02_design/preview/ with per-screen state variants and a fidelity disclaimer banner

traceability.json maps every Feature List FEAT and TC to stable data-wh-* DOM anchors where the behavior is visible, and each anchor exposes a keyboard-accessible FEAT badge that opens related feature and test-case details

before snapshot approval every interactive surface is classified: repeated entity labels are covered by their existing navigation/list anchor, existing behavior on another surface gains another anchor, and truly unplanned user behavior returns to feature-planner for REQ/FEAT/TC and decision-log write-back instead of being silently omitted or assigned a feature from its seed label
preview feedback is applied to the design specs first by the owning designer and the preview is regenerated — the preview files are never treated as the source of truth

the approved source, preview, and traceability hashes are recorded append-only in design-review.md; any later source or preview change derives STALE and blocks Phase 3 until regeneration and reapproval, while planning-level changes return to Feature List refinement

prompt: 주문 상세 화면에 배송지 변경 기능을 추가해줘. 결제 완료 상태에서만 가능하고 변경 전 확인 dialog가 필요해.
assertions: after the Phase 1 confirmation, feature-plan.md's Feature List is updated with a stable FEAT id and requirements.md is refreshed via lightweight re-invocation of the owning planning agents
a PC-NNN entry is appended to decision-log.md with trigger, target ids, before→after, approval, and affected artifacts
the change is not implemented as an unrecorded change — a missing write-back is flagged by code-reviewer

prompt: 기획 문서가 바뀐 기존 프로젝트를 검증해줘. decision-log의 과거 엔트리 하나가 수정된 상태야.
assertions: code-reviewer reports a modified or deleted existing PC entry in decision-log.md as FAIL (append-only violation)
planning document diffs without a corresponding PC entry are reported as WARN (unrecorded change)
reviewers do not rewrite the log themselves — the fix is routed to product-planner as the owning agent

prompt: Vite SPA + serverless 구성에 엔드포인트를 하나 더 추가해줘. 기존 api/analyze.js는 인증·body 32KB 캡·스키마 검증·rate limit이 다 있고, 새로 만들 api/data.js는 로그인 사용자의 전체 데이터를 GET/PUT하는 스냅샷 동기화야.
assertions: the new endpoint carries all five guards from SKILL.md §7 (method allowlist, auth guard, body size cap, input schema validation, rate limit) — not merely the subset the request mentions
the PUT snapshot path validates the request body server-side per row with array-length and string-length bounds; Array.isArray alone is reported as insufficient
guards are implemented as shared _lib/ modules rather than re-written per handler
the highest-defense sibling handler (api/analyze.js) is used as the baseline, and a guard present there but absent in the new handler is treated as a defect
client-side validation is never accepted as a substitute for server-side validation on the write path
new Vercel Node handlers prefer the current Web Standard Request/Response contract and the Vite dev adapter preserves streaming body limits instead of buffering an unbounded body first

prompt: serverless 함수에서 외부 LLM API를 호출하는 엔드포인트를 만들어줘. 서버에 저장된 API 키를 쓰고, 소유자 제한은 ALLOWED_EMAIL 환경변수로 켤 생각이야.
assertions: the paid upstream call happens only after the auth guard passes — cost is never incurred before authorization
when ALLOWED_EMAIL is unset or blank the paid path fails closed (503-style) rather than fail-open, and the fail-open/fail-closed split is stated explicitly
a rate limit bounds the paid path per user or IP, and its serverless limitation (per-instance memory, cold-start reset) is disclosed rather than presented as a hard guarantee
prompt bodies and model response text are excluded from logs; only structured scalars are logged

the endpoint guard matrix (§7) is reported with no gaps; a checked-in or host-run golden remains T0, and even a checked-in T1 workflow proposal remains preparation until its protected environment and isolated runner produce a passing single-cohort summary
the compatible profile does not claim certified production evidence without actual provider evidence and external attestation

prompt: 브랜드 아이덴티티가 차별점인 소비자 대상 포트폴리오·쇼케이스 웹서비스를 만들어줘. 디자인 자유도가 최우선이야.
assertions: tech-stack.md records UI_LANE: tailwind-shadcn with a one-line rationale tied to the lib-catalog decision axis (design as differentiator)
vendored primitives land under src/shared/ui with explicit named exports, and no src/components/ui or components.json appears
vendored Radix- or Base UI-based files preserve aria/role/Portal/focus wiring, with a one-line rationale on any deviation
node .claude/scripts/validate-ui-lane.mjs --project reports PASS with no @mui or @emotion imports in src
tokens live in src/app/style.css @theme derived from the design-system output, with no feature-local palettes or arbitrary color values

prompt: 기존 MUI 기반 어드민 앱에 알림 설정 화면을 추가해줘. 새 화면도 기존 디자인과 똑같은 톤이어야 해.
assertions: integration-overlay.json records uiLibrary.uiLane: mui from the existing app, and that measurement takes precedence over any fresh lane preference
the new screen uses the existing MUI theme and shared components — no tailwindcss, cva, or tailwind-merge dependency is introduced
node .claude/scripts/validate-ui-lane.mjs --project reports PASS against the overlay-declared mui lane
existing screens' observable appearance is preserved per the minimal-change baseline rule

prompt: 승인된 발산 시안 B(색·타이포·radius·밀도·그림자 5축이 현행 디자인과 모두 다름)를 기존 앱에 적용해줘. 시안 문서와 현행 design-system이 프로젝트에 있어.
assertions: the implementation plan scopes all five axes of the approved candidate (color, typography, radius/shape, spacing/density, shadow/accent) — a recolor-only framing of the revision never survives planning
the IMPLEMENTATION-VERDICT cross-check table is produced at the contract-fixed location with per-axis evidence before completion is declared
a builder completion report that declares a narrower scope than the approved candidate (e.g. 'task scope is color-only') is escalated as a blocker instead of being passed through
post-implementation verification explicitly checks at least one non-color axis (typography, radius, or spacing) against the approved candidate

prompt: 로딩 스켈레톤이 있는 검색 결과 화면을 설계해줘. 디자인 토큰 체계에 duration-base(200ms, 인터랙션 전환용)가 이미 정의돼 있어.
assertions: the component spec does not prescribe an interaction-transition token as a looping animation period — skeleton shimmer duration is derived from a loop-appropriate value with its own rationale
design review checks token semantics (what each token is for) rather than only token existence when a spec consumes a token outside its declared purpose
if the spec author cannot justify a token choice against its declared purpose, the mismatch is surfaced as a spec defect rather than passing spec-conformance checks

prompt: PRD 문서랑 대시보드 화면 시안 이미지 2장이 있어. 이걸로 관리자 대시보드 만들어줘. 시안은 대시보드랑 설정 화면만 있고 나머지 3개 화면은 아직 없어.
assertions: the new lane asks the three provenance questions before starting and records PLAN_SOURCE and DESIGN_SOURCE as supplied rather than inferring them, and the supplied design is confirmed as which artifact form it takes (document, link, image, or Figma MCP)

source-artifact-ingestor writes _workspace/00_source/source-index.md in the inventory-table form with a required 소비 지점 column naming which normalized artifact each source became, and every named artifact carries a ## Source Trace that cites the same snapshot back

partial supply is recorded as coverage rather than as a label: the two supplied screens are normalized and the three missing ones are filled by the design wave and marked ASSUMPTION, with the mix disclosed in the completion report instead of a bare 디자인: supplied

design evidence attribution lands in _workspace/00_source/design-binding.json keyed by (pageGroup, condition) with declaredBy limited to user or carried, and unbound or pending entries are surfaced at the Phase 1 to 2 checkpoint instead of being resolved silently
validate-handoff-readiness --to design is actually run at the Phase 1 to 2 checkpoint and its verdict is shown, with the reported strength being advisory rather than an automatic block

the ux-brief information-hierarchy table is emitted with 형:이름 headers so the condition denominator is machine readable, and blank condition cells are reported as NEEDS_DECISION rather than passed over

prompt: 이 기획서로 예약 서비스 만들어줘. 문서에 정원 초과 시 어떻게 할지랑 재방문자 온보딩 재노출 여부는 안 적혀 있어.
assertions: the two gaps the source document does not answer are classified as QUESTION rather than ASSUMPTION, because they are product decisions only the original author can settle, and 일반적 관행 is explicitly rejected as a reason for an ASSUMPTION

a self-contained _workspace/00_source/author-questions.md is produced in the language of the source document, where each item carries a Q-NNN id, the location in the original, what is blocked without an answer, and a 막음 or 나중 marker, and any option list always includes a none-of-these choice
items marked 막음 also appear as BLOCKER in gap-report.md cross-referenced by the same Q-NNN, because the orchestrator and completion conditions only read BLOCKER

items marked 나중 leave a QUESTION(Q-NNN) marker in the normalized artifact instead of silently becoming an unexplained ASSUMPTION, so the place that must not be implemented without a decision stays visible
when there are zero QUESTION items the file is not created at all and an INFO line is left in gap-report.md instead, so not asking and having nothing to ask stay distinguishable

answers from the author are recorded in decision-log.md with attribution and time while the original document is never edited, and any needed source change is only proposed in source-change-proposals.md

prompt: create 모드로 개발 티켓 초안만 써줘(트래커에 만들지 않는다 — `create --confirm`을 실행하지 않는다). 작업: 홈 화면에 최근 본 항목 섹션을 추가하고, 날짜 표기는 shared의 formatDate를 쓴다. 두 티켓 이하로 나눈다.
assertions: a draft file exists under _workspace/03_dev/ticket-drafts/ and every ticket in it is a `## 제목` block with the four required sections 목적·작업 내용·완료 조건·선행·협의 (optional 수정 범위·하지 않는 것 allowed, no other section names)
every 완료 조건 item is a `- ` list line stating an observable result, not an intention
the drafts contain no FEAT-/TC- requirement IDs and every path they name is inside the spec layerMap (src/app, src/pages, src/shared) or testLayers
the executor never ran `create` with `--confirm` (no tracker ticket was created)

prompt: 설정 화면이 없어서 /settings 로 가면 빈 화면이 나온다. 버그니까 고쳐줘.
